reason: It is a concept, not a live product, from a design studio that has not shown me a single client or result. I would not hand my customer messages to an agent I cannot verify, and I am not paying for a nice carousel.
objection: Will better design actually bring more customers? I have seen plenty of slick new looks and my customers still came or did not come based on price and whether they trust us.
would_change_my_mind: Real businesses like mine using it, with named results I can call and check, and a local team I can meet.
